integrity: The proof is symbolic. Exhaustive computation through order 10 is used only as a finite stress test and coefficient cross-check, not as evidence for the infinite theorem.
limitations: The theorem is restricted to connected complete multipartite graphs. The literature comparison found no arbitrary complete-multipartite all-set enumeration, but poor indexing or alternate terminology remains a residual bibliographic risk.
title: Neighborhood total \(2\)-domination polynomial of complete multipartite graphs
